immigration.headline: Cuban Alien Arrested for Unlawfully Voting
immigration.body: A Cuban alien was arrested after being charged with unlawful voting by an alien. U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services assisted the investigation.

immigration.headline: Former Medical Doctor Convicted of Naturalization Fraud
immigration.body: U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services provided critical assistance to the investigation leading to the conviction of a former medical doctor for naturalization fraud.

immigration.headline: Italian Alien Charged With Voting in 2024 General Election and Lying About It
immigration.body: U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services provided critical assistance in the investigation that led to a federal indictment charging Andrea Catanese, 60, an Italian national, with voting by an alien, attempting to unlawfully procure naturalization, and making a false statement in connection with naturalization.

immigration.headline: Former Syrian Prison Official Sentenced for Torture and Immigration Fraud
immigration.body: U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services assisted with the case that led to the sentencing of Samir Ousman Alsheikh, 74, a former Syrian prison warden and provincial governor.

immigration.headline: Federal Grand Jury Indicts Ten Aliens for Voter Fraud in Minnesota Elections
immigration.body: Defendants illegally voted in the November 2022 and 2024 general elections and the August 2026 primary election
